spans.s:
mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Wishing to see.
E.
दृश to see, desid. form, शानच् aff.

f. (-क्षा)
Desire or wish to see.
E.
दृश to see, desid. form, अङ् and टाप aff.

mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु)
Desirous of seeing.
E.
दृश to see, desid. form, उ aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Wishing to see.
E.
दिदृक्षा, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षत्)
Wishing to play or sport.
E.
दिव to play, desid. form, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-द्युत्)
Shining, blazing, bright.
E.
द्यु to shine, शतृ affix, intens. form.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Wishing to shine.
E.
द्यु to shine, desid. form, उ aff.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Destroying.
E.
दी, and द who or what gives.

mfn. (-विः-विः-वि)
Risen, ascended.
mn. (-विः-वि)
Boiled rice.
m. (-विः)
A name of VṚHASPATI.
E.
दिव to play, Uṇādi affix क्विन्, the radical reduplicate, deriv. irr.
